_about: How flh_sampler turns FL's raw Sampler channel values into ms / Hz / %. Raw ranges come from the FLP format (PyFLP docs; they match FL 2026 files). The ms and Hz curves are ESTIMATES until checked on a PC (checklists/sampler.md): set a value with the tool, hover the knob in FL, read the hint, adjust max_ms / exp / min_hz / max_hz here. Ratio moves ('x2') depend only on exp.
